corrected_code:
class ClinicalEntriesController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_practitioner!

  def create
    patient = current_practitioner.assigned_patients.find(params[:patient_id])
    @entry = patient.clinical_entries.build(entry_params)
    @entry.recorded_by = current_practitioner
    @entry.save!
    render json: @entry, status: :created
  end

  private

  def entry_params
    params.require(:clinical_entry).permit(:icd_code, :notes, :dosage)
  end
end
